# Included dependency

The Android companion includes Shizuku API 13.1.5, developed by Rikka and
contributors under the MIT license. Its license is in
[Shizuku-API-LICENSE.txt](Shizuku-API-LICENSE.txt).

Source: https://github.com/RikkaApps/Shizuku-API

The local build fetches the API, provider, AIDL and shared artifacts from Maven
Central. Versions and SHA-256 checksums are pinned in `android/dependencies.json`.
The separate Shizuku manager app is not bundled. Install it from its official
download page when using on-device activation.

AndroidX annotation 1.3.0 is included under the Apache License 2.0. Its license
is in [AndroidX-annotation-LICENSE.txt](AndroidX-annotation-LICENSE.txt).
Source: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/support/
